surfaces.OMEGA-SW-01: Omega identity bind to OpenAgents account

steps.title: Install the candidate from a clean profile
steps.evidence: Requires a signed Omega candidate and a clean local profile.

steps.title: Bind the Omega identity to the OpenAgents account
Open the workroom pane
Confirm the principal reference, conversation reference, and authority revision
Sarah authenticates to the owned relay with an attested key
The owner sends a message only the owner and Sarah can decrypt
The relay operator cannot read the conversation content
Ask Sarah for current release state and read the cited answer
steps.evidence: Requires live Sarah release tools on an installed candidate.

steps.title: Ask for coding capacity and observe the live tool ladder with no gap
Ask her to control an existing Full Auto run; pending stays pending until the host applies it
steps.evidence: Requires live Full Auto host application path on Omega.

steps.title: Trigger one refusal; the signed receipt names its reserved category
Interrupt one turn; confirm the terminal event
Restart Omega mid-turn; one honest outcome, never two answers
steps.evidence: terminal claim unreclaimable; capacity turn has one turn.finished

steps.title: The durable ladder replays after restart from relay history alone
steps.evidence: replayed 4 durable events from memory relay

steps.title: Kill omega-effectd; recovery without a duplicate answer
The exact token_usage_events row and the signed NIP-AM metric agree
steps.evidence: exact row totals match NIP-AM metric body

steps.title: A second admitted relay serves the same history after the first is stopped
An event signed while offline publishes after reconnection
A stale, duplicate, unsigned, revoked, and unauthorized input is each rejected and starts no turn
An export verifies the causal chain without reading Cloud SQL
steps.evidence: export walked 7 durable events; 2 with e-tag parents; no Cloud SQL read

steps.title: Disconnect the network; a visible degraded state, not a hang
Confirm no token, credential, or private path appears in any log
steps.evidence: mock log projection is public-safe; no secret fields

steps.title: Remove Omega; confirm Zed and Electron data did not change
steps.evidence: Requires a clean install/remove comparison on the owner machine.

independentReviewer.executionIdentityNote: Requires a distinct execution identity separate from the producer agent.

checklist.check: All automated steps are passed or honestly failed
No secret field, nsec, or private path appears in the receipt
Human residual steps are listed and not marked as live proof
Producer agent did not also accept this receipt
Live install/bind/UI steps remain open until a signed Omega candidate is used
